134522: Galo Thymos is the Burning Rescue's newest recruit. Set with a burning passion to extinguish all that is wrong, you can expect Galo to rush in first to the scene of an emergency. His 'Burning Soul' is his strongest characteristic.
134523: The leader of Mad Burnish. Lio seems like someone who keeps his cool, but it's actually the opposite. Lio aims to burn everything with the power of a special flame called "Burnish Flare".
134524: A member of Burning Rescue, in charge of heavy machinery. He's a muscular guy in his 30s, and he's always training his body. He partners with the diminutive Lucia when out on a job.
134525: A small mechanic at Burning Rescue. She handles the development and maintenance of Burning Rescue's equipment. She also constructed Galo's Matoi.
134526: The captain of Burning Rescue, in his 30s. On missions he makes wise decisions and leads the other members. He trusts his team and they trust him.
134527: A member of Burning Rescue who, like Galo, is in her teens. She is cool, calm, and professional at all times, and does things at her own pace. She plays the straight man to Galo and Varys.
134528: The administrator of the Independent Republic of Promepolis and chief director of the Foresight Foundation. He used to research fireproof building materials, but successfully developed an instant-freeze bullet that can put out a Burnish fire. Galo looks up to him.
134529: The vice-captain of Burning Rescue. He's a good-looking guy in his 20s, and he is as smart as he looks. He is an indispensable adviser to the captain Ignis.
153745: A leading member of Mad Burnish along with his comrades Lio and Meis.
153746: Aina’s sister and a young female doctor who belongs to the Foresight Laboratory and is a member of Burning Rescue. She works for a very peculiar development in the laboratory…
153747: Vulcan is the Colonel of Freeze Force, a police and military organization responsible for war against Burnish crimes and attacks, specifically Mad Burnish. A hardened, mildly hysterical man whose more than a little enthusiastic about both his position and mission.
153748: A scientist who has been researching Burnish for many years as a national research team. Much about the man and his research remains a mystery.
153749: Biar is the personal secretary of Kray Foresight, the Executive Vice President of the Autonomous Republic of Promepolis, and President of the Foresight Foundation. She acts together with Kray and executes the instructions she receives to a tee.
153750: A rat in uniform, or at least wearing a helmet, who lives in the National Emergency Rescue Service, FDPP. Vinny is the the mascot of Burning Rescue and usually works with Lucia who is in charge of mechanics.
153751: A high-ranking member of Mad Burnish. He acts as a right-hand man to Lio and works alongside Gueira, knowing him well before even meeting Lio.
153752: A hesitant woman who struggles with her newfound circumstances, Thyma is one of the first Burnish featured in the shorts. She first appeared in Galo-hen being rescued by Galo.
